description: This Java source file defines the `ToyVpnConnection` class, which manages the establishment and maintenance of a VPN connection within an Android application. It implements `Runnable` and handles tasks such as connecting to a VPN server, performing a handshake, configuring the VPN interface, and maintaining the connection through keepalives and timeouts.

classes.name: ToyVpnConnection
classes.description: Represents a VPN connection that handles connection setup, handshake, interface configuration, and keepalive maintenance within an Android environment.

classes.name: ToyVpnConnection.OnEstablishListener
classes.description: Callback interface to notify when the VPN connection has been established, providing the virtual interface descriptor.

methods.name: setConfigureIntent
methods.description: Sets an optional PendingIntent to allow VPN configuration.

methods.name: setOnEstablishListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be notified when the VPN connection is established.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method to manage VPN connection lifecycle, including attempts to connect and maintain the tunnel.

methods.name: run(SocketAddress)
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the VPN server, authenticate, configure the VPN interface, and handle ongoing packet forwarding.

methods.name: handshake
methods.description: Performs a handshake with the VPN server to establish a secure tunnel using a shared secret.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the VPN interface based on parameters received from the server, applying specified network settings and application permissions.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns a string used for logging purposes, identifying the class and connection ID.
